title: Voltage Glitching Unlocks Disabled A100 Hardware in Mining Card
summary: A first-hand hardware-hacking write-up reports using voltage glitching to defeat fuse-disabled capabilities in an NVIDIA mining card, presented as a way to unlock A100 hardware. The account describes a physical attack on fuses rather than a software workaround; discussion identifies the card as the 8GB CMP 170HX. It is the author’s experimental result, not an NVIDIA-supported modification or an independently verified finding.
